#1.7.0 Details
 
Agents! These are the 1.7.0 Details!
 
▣ New Character – Jessica Jones –
 
After 1.7.0 Update, Jessica Jones will join the fight for the future!
 
 
Due to the addition of a new character, new Team Bonus Effects & New Achievement have been added
 
▣ 4 New Uniforms


 
 4 new uniforms have been added for Iron Fist, Daredevil, Daisy Johnson and Doctor Octopus.
 

 * New uniforms are only available for a limited time.
 * You may check new uniforms in Marvel Universe and Uniform Shop.

 
▣ New 6★ Skills for 11 Characters
 
 New 6★ Skills have been added for the following characters
  • Daredevil, Daisy Johnson, Lincoln Campbell, Sif, Deathlok, Phil Coulson, Malekith, Angela, Ultron, Mockingbird, Doctor Octopus
 

 

 
1. Daisy Johnson: Quake
2. Phil Coulson: The Captain Card
3. Malekith: The Accursed
4. Lincoln Campbell: Electrical Field


 
5. Daredevil: Blind Sided
6. Mockingbird: Bo–Staff Take Down
 

 
7. Angela: Entangle
8. Ultron: No Strings
 

 
9. Deathlok: Perfect Shot
10. Sif: For Honor!
11. Doctor Octopus: Armed and Dangerous
 

▣ Character Balancing
 
 Range for certain skills have been rebalanced. Overall stats for universal characters have been improved, too!
 
 1. Character Balancing
  - 10 Characters have been revamped so they can plough enemies more effectively.
 
  
1) Daredevil
- Damage increased for "Billy Club Shot" and it attacks more effectively
- Damage decreased slightly for "Blind Strike" and it attacks more effectively
- Damage decreased slightly for "Club Swing" and it starts to attack faster
- Damage decreased slightly for "Staff Splash" and hits more times
- Enemies will get pulled to Dare Devil when uses the skill “Staff Splash”
 
2) Doctor Octopus: 
- “Tentacle Block” will give a buff first and push enemies back.
 
3) Thor (including Uniform)
- Damage of last hit increased for "Battle Rage" (Cooldown Time reduced to 12 Seconds)
- Cooldown time decreased for “Thundering Maelstrom”, from 25 seconds to 13 seconds.
 
4) Malekith
- Damage increased for "Storm of the Aether"
 
5) Punisher (including Uniform)
- Cooldown Time decreased for "Incendiary Rocket" from 25 to 14 seconds
 
6) Punisher – Noir
- Damage increased for normal attack
- Uniform bonus modified
    Before : Inflict damage by 24% of Maximum HP
    After : Physical Attack +10% for 20 seconds (Cooldown Time : 30 Seconds)
- Damage increased for "Killer Instinct"
 
7) Black Bolt
- Damage increased for "Quasi-Sonic Scream"
- Cooldown Time decreased for "Quasi-Sonic Scream" from 27 to 15 seconds
 
8) Deathlok (including Uniform)
- Damage increased for normal attack
- Damage increased for "S.H.I.E.L.D. Soldier"
- Damage increased for "Covering Fire"
- Damage increased for "Upgraded Missile"
 
9) Lincoln Campbell
- Damage increased for normal attack
- Damage increased for "Terrigenics"
- Damage increased for "Electromagnetism"
- Damage increased for "Protective Dome"
- Damage increased for "Magnetic Repulsion"
 
10) Hulk/Maestro-Secret Wars: Future Imperfect
- HP, Physical Atk/Def increased.
 
2. Attack range modification
  - Fixed an issue with certain skills' range to destroy enemies more effectively.
  

  1) Bullseye: Fixed an issue with "Storm of Swords" where it did not hit correct when Bullseye stacked with an enemy.
  2) Black Bolt: Fixed a skill range issue with "Power Word", "Brutal Whisper", "Quasi-Sonic Scream"
  3) Iron Man (including Uniform): Fixed an issue with "Repulsor Ray" that does not hit correct when Iron man stacked with an enemy
  4) Angela (including Uniform): Fixed an issue with "Avenging Angel" that does not hit correctly after spinning attack.
  5) Venom (including Uniform): Fixed an issue with "Symbiote Surge" that does not hit correctly when Venom stacked with an enemy
  6) Ultron (including Uniform): Fixed an issue with "Chest Beam" and "Electronic Field" that does not hit occasionally
  7) Thor (including Uniform): Fixed an issue with "Thundering Maestrom" that does not hit occasionally
  8) Deathlok (including Uniform): Fixed an issue with laser beam in skill "S.H.I.E.L.D. Soldier" that does not hit correctly
  9) Nebula: Fixed an issue with "Vicious Spree" that does not hit correctly when Nebula stacked with an enemy
 
 3. Universal Type Modification
  - All universal characters now give more damage on Combat, Speed, and Blast type characters
 

 
 4. Universal Character Stat Modification
 
  1) Ghost Rider (including Uniform)
   - Increase in Energy Atk, Physical/Energy Def, and HP
 
  2) Groot - Secret Wars: Thors
   - Decreased HP slightly
 
  3) Destroyer
   - Increase in Energy Atk, Physical/Energy Def, and HP
 
  4) Ronan
   - Increase in Energy Atk, Physical/Energy Def, and HP
 
  5) Black Bolt
   - Increase in Energy Atk, Physical/Energy Def, and HP
 
  6) Singularity
   - Increase in Energy Atk, Physical Def, and HP
   - Decrease in Physical Atk slightly
 
  7) Angela (including Uniform)
   - Increase in Physical Atk/Def and HP
   - Decrease in Energy Atk/Def slightly
 
  8) Ultron (including Uniform)
   - Increase in Physical/Energy Atk, Physical Def, and HP
 
  9) Captain Marvel (including Uniform)
   - Increase in Physical Atk/Def, Energy Atk/Def, and HP
 
  10) Thor (including Uniform)
   - Increase in Physical Atk/Def, Energy Atk/Def, and HP
 
 
▣ Auto Repeat Improvement
 
 Find out about the new changes that lets you use the auto repeat more easily.
 

 
 1. New options added
   - Now you may find new option that lets you configure event pop-up setting while auto repeating, including;
   1) Daily Biometrics Acquired
   2) Special Mission Chapter Completion 100%
   3) Dimension Rift Discovered
 
 2. S.H.I.L.E.D. Level up pop-up now shows during Auto Repeating
  - The pop-up will close in 3 seconds automatically without needing the player to tap the screen.
 
 3. If you auto repeat, Clear Ticket now consumes after 2nd round.
  - First round does not consume any Clear Ticket, but next (2nd) auto repeat will start consuming Clear Tickets.
 
 
▣Token Shop Update
We are changing the contents of the token stores. See the below image for more details!

 

▣ Other Improvements
 
1. Spamming in Chat is no longer possible.
2. Cover effect and ISO-8 Set effect now works simultaneously.
3. Level cap for each rank rebalanced.


4. Shield, Energy Shield, Physical Shield now works simultaneously
   ※ but It does not stack same shield effect
5. One character can use 2 or more summoning skill
6. New 3~6★ Hero Chest X 5 has been added for 2,000 Crystals.
